integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo stated classical prime-density and elementary valuation results; a finite exact-integer verifier corroborates formulas through n=200 for 280 parameter-prime pairs, not an independent proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to fixed positive integer P and Q=-1; does not determine companion realizability-prime densities or any effective prime distribution errors. Classical P=1 and P=2 cases, general Lucas valuation lemmas, and square-discriminant companion results are prior; an unindexed uniform statement remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Uniform local Dold classifications for negative-unit Lucas pairs
